title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
summary: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

title: Crypto made new friends in U.S. primaries, but focus now shifts to general election
summary: Adding Massachusetts incumbent Auchincloss to the list of winning primary candidates Fairshake supported, the industry's influence moves on to November.

title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets
summary: After multiple appeals courts ruled differently about whether states can crack down on prediction markets' sports products, New Jersey asked SCOTUS to step in.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto VCs are mistaking consensus for discipline
summary: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Varun Datta of Truth Ventures writes that crypto venture capital's retreat to later-stage deals is a consensus trade dressed as discipline. With proven companies taking 57% of last quarter's capital, he argues the founding-stage gap is where the returns are, and lays out three things to look for.

title: CrowdStrike and federal authorities dismantle Russian malware that secretly stole crypto for 8 years
summary: Russia-based Sality watched for copied bitcoin and Ethereum addresses and quietly replaced them with the attacker’s. CrowdStrike and law enforcement have now isolated more than 15,000 infected machines.
